nodes.name: regression_smoke.sh
nodes.summary: Regression smoke runner that stamps an ISO timestamp and short git revision, then executes the full pytest suite for the DutchBay v14 model.

nodes.name: run_all_suites.sh
nodes.summary: Orchestrates a multi-phase test run (CLI smoke, scenario multi-file emit, matrix/strict validator, then the heavy modules suite with deterministic Monte Carlo shims) under relaxed coverage gates.

nodes.name: run_api_cov_smoke.sh
nodes.summary: Generates and runs a minimal import/coverage smoke test for the dutchbay_v13 api and adapters surfaces, including a best-effort CLI --help touch, with a gentle coverage threshold.

nodes.name: run_cli_scenarios_fast.sh
nodes.summary: Fast CLI scenario driver that invokes the dutchbay_v13 scenarios command over the inputs directory, emitting both formats plus annual outputs and listing the resulting artifacts.

nodes.name: run_core_hardened.sh
nodes.summary: Hardened core/config test pass running the core import-stack and core tests with coverage focused on the config and validate modules.

nodes.name: run_heavy_modules_suite.sh
nodes.summary: Patches Monte Carlo for deterministic RNG then runs best-effort smoke tests across the Monte Carlo, sensitivity, optimization, and metrics modules, tolerating expected xfails.

nodes.name: run_heavy_with_shims.sh
nodes.summary: Installs non-intrusive API shims and assertive tests, then runs the heavy analytics suite (Monte Carlo, sensitivity, optimization, metrics) under a relaxed coverage gate.

nodes.name: run_import_surface_sweep.sh
nodes.summary: Generates an import-surface test asserting every key dutchbay_v13 module (api, config, core, finance, monte_carlo, reporting, epc) loads, then runs it with narrow coverage across those surfaces.

nodes.name: run_next_modules_suite.sh
nodes.summary: Adds reporting and core/config smoke tests via helper scripts and then runs the reporting and core module test suites in sequence.

nodes.name: run_next_tests.sh
nodes.summary: Runs CLI smoke and scenario tests in permissive validation mode, then validator-behavior tests in strict mode, toggling VALIDATION_MODE between phases with relaxed coverage gates.

nodes.name: run_reporting_cli_smoke.sh
nodes.summary: Reporting smoke test that imports dutchbay_v13.report and report_pdf, generates stub report and PDF outputs into a scratch directory, and asserts the output files exist.

nodes.name: run_reporting_hardened.sh
nodes.summary: Hardened reporting test pass running the reporting import-stack and reporting tests with coverage focused on the report, report_pdf, and charts modules.
